tasks.notes: PAT expires 2026-11-29. When it expires the Worker gets HTTP 401 and /add etc. stop being instant (the daily cron still works). Fix: create a new fine-grained PAT with Contents: write on Mozi-E/tv-tracker, then Cloudflare -> Worker -> Settings -> Variables and Secrets -> edit GH_TOKEN. Then bump this date to the new expiry and commit.
